intent: The words of the Hypernormal site, as an app. State is exactly {sections: [{id, title, body}]}, in display order. id is a stable slug, title is a heading, body is plain text with blank lines between paragraphs (no HTML; faces escape and split on blank lines). A face renders the sections in order. Only the owner edits; everyone reads. The one verb, edit_section, changes a section's title or body by id and returns the updated section's id and title, or fails with the list of valid ids.

edit_section.description: Owner only. Edit one section's title and/or body by id.
edit_section.code: const s = (ctx.state.sections ?? []).find(function (x) { return x.id === ctx.input.id; }); if (!s) throw new Error('no section "' + ctx.input.id + '"; ids: ' + (ctx.state.sections ?? []).map(function (x) { return x.id; }).join(', ')); if (ctx.input.title !== undefined) s.title = ctx.input.title; if (ctx.input.body !== undefined) s.body = ctx.input.body; return { id: s.id, title: s.title };
